title: Never have I… 倒裝句
subtitle: Not only・Never have I・Hardly had

lines.say: Never have I seen 這種句子，為什麼主詞跑到後面？
今天學倒裝句，讓英文聽起來更有力。

slides.head: Never have I + p.p.
points: Never have I seen so much rain.

lines.say: 第一個，否定詞放句首，助動詞就要跑到主詞前面。
Never have I seen so much rain!
lines.zh: 我從來沒看過這麼多雨！

lines.say: Welcome to Ireland!
比 I have never seen 更有戲劇效果。

slides.head: Not only… but also
points: Not only is it cheap, but it's also close.
not only 放句首要倒裝

lines.say: 第二個，Not only 放句首，後面也要倒裝。
Not only is the flat cheap, but it's also close to work.
lines.zh: 這間公寓不但便宜，離公司也很近。

lines.say: Take it before someone else does!
lines.zh: 趁別人還沒搶走，快租下來！

lines.say: is the flat，be 動詞跑到主詞前面了。

slides.head: Hardly had… when
points: Hardly had I arrived when it rained.

lines.say: 第三個，Hardly had 加 when，表示才剛…就…。
Hardly had I sat down when my phone rang.
lines.zh: 我才剛坐下，手機就響了。

lines.say: Typical!
寫作或演講時用，會讓你的英文更高級。
小測驗！想說：我從沒看過這麼長的隊伍。
Never blank such a long queue.
空格要填什麼？A、B、還是 C？
答案是 B！Never 放句首要倒裝：have I seen。
今天學會了三種倒裝句！
打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。我們下次見！
